questions.question: Missing data may be suitably assumed. 1A Derive decision parameters for Bresenham line algorithm and how they are used to draw next points on the line. 1B Assume a predictor , quantization functions as below: and Assume the input signal has values as follows: 20 38 56 74 92 110. Calculate reconstructed signals (three values) according to DPCM coding scheme. 1C Discuss four advantages of Vector graphics. (5 + 3 + 2) 2A (i) Briefly discuss the problems addressed by JPEG2000 standard. (ii) What is dithering? Write steps in Random dithering. 2B Generate first 3 points (in 1st octant) on the circle with centre (10, 10) & radius-9 using mid- point circle algorithm. 2C Describe three kinds of frame coding used in MPEG-1 and find the coding & transmission order of frames if the display order of frames is - I B B P B B P B B I ? (5 + 3 + 2) PME-314 Page 1 of 3 3A Along with neat block diagram of JPEG encoder, explain RLC coding and DPCM coding steps with example. 3B Assume that relative frequencies of following symbols in a document as below: A B C D R 40 20 10^10 20 Calculate entropy and assign codes to each of symbols according to Huffman coding. 3C Write a HTML code to display an image MU.png and the text -‘Inspired By Life’ over it (use z-index). (5 + 3 + 2) 4A Explain three type of java script popup boxes with an example for each. 4B Write a HTML code to take vehicle Registration Number (for example: KA19-P0679) as input in text box. On click of a button, using Regular expressions validate Registration number format and display proper message in pop-up box. 4C Discuss RSVP protocol used to guarantee desired QoS for multimedia transmission. (5 + 3 + 2) 5A Write HTML code to display following table on a web page. 5B Along with example, discuss any three methods supported by Java Script String object. 5C What is the meaning of if m in GIF screen descriptor is 1 and 1st byte (0010^1100), m=1 and i=1 in GIF image descriptor? (5+3+2) PME-314 Page 2 of 3 6A Write HTML/CSS code to display data collection form to collect following Personal Information(use appropriate form elements)- Name of person, Email, Phone, Age , Gender( default female),Country (user has to select any one from these-India, United States, Japan, Australia, Others) Hobbies- person may be having none or one or-more hobbies such as Cooking, Gardening, Fishing, and Cycling. Group all these as My Hobbies. Provide the user a provision for entering password and a submit button. Show Name, Email, Age and Password with red border to make it mandatory fields. Rest fields with blue. 6B Discuss any six text formatting tags in CSS with example for each. 6C Discuss horizontal retrace, vertical retrace, video interlacing and significance of interlacing. (5 + 3 + 2) ****************** PME-314 Page 3 of 3
